summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new password management features, CSV export functionality, Newsletter admin page, CMS-driven Privacy Policy, and index.html cleanup. All new features working correctly with 100% frontend pass rate and 95.3% backend pass rate. No regressions detected.

flaky_endpoints.issue: Rate limiting inconsistent during rapid testing (hit 429 on 3rd request instead of 6th)
flaky_endpoints.impact: Minor - rate limiting is working but timing is slightly unpredictable during automated tests

Backend: Admin password reset endpoint (PUT /api/admin/users/{id}/password) - admin can set new password for any user
Backend: Newsletter subscribers endpoint (GET /api/admin/newsletter-subscribers) - returns list of subscribers
Backend: Privacy policy fields in global settings (privacy_policy_updated_date, privacy_policy_content) - present and populated
Frontend: Admin Login password visibility toggles - show/hide password working
Frontend: Admin Login Reset Password flow - form navigation, all password fields have toggles, successful reset returns to login
Frontend: Admin Login Reset Password error handling - incorrect current password shows error, stays on form
Frontend: Admin Users Add User form password toggle - show/hide working
Frontend: Admin Users Reset Password dialog - opens correctly, has toggles on both password fields
Frontend: Admin Users Reset Password flow - creates test user, resets password, verifies new password works, deletes test user
Frontend: Admin Inquiries CSV Export button - present and functional (data-testid=admin-inquiries-export-button)
Frontend: Admin Newsletter page - accessible from sidebar, table displays subscribers (data-testid=admin-newsletter-table)
Frontend: Admin Newsletter CSV Export button - present and functional (data-testid=admin-newsletter-export-button)
Frontend: Privacy Policy page - CMS-driven content renders correctly with sections, updated date, mailto links
Frontend: Privacy Policy contact email placeholder substitution - {{contact_email}} replaced with actual email
Frontend: Admin Settings Legal section - privacy_policy_updated_date and privacy_policy_content fields present and editable
Frontend: index.html cleanup - title 'Bretton J. Key', meta description correct, favicon present (HTTP 200)
Frontend: index.html cleanup - NO PostHog scripts, NO emergent-main.js, NO assets.emergent.sh references
Regression: Original admin login (brettonjkey@icloud.com / #Test1234) still works
